title: Sonographic Detection of Prophylactic Pancreatic Stents
brief_summary: The Retention of pancreatic stents for prophylaxis of post-ERCP pancreatitis (PEP) is assessed by abdominal x-ray according to international Guidelines. The current study aimed to analyze whether prophylactic pancreatic stents can be detected by transdermal ultrasound to save the x-ray examination.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patient after pancreatic stent placement for prophylaxis of post-ERCP pancreatitis
* age 18-79
* signed informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* any disease that rules out study participation
* patient not legally competent to sign informed consent
* chronic pancreatis as indication for pancreatic stenting
